column2: [intro]
I love watching people, it’s my passion
Their little quirks, their imagination
On the street, at the café, wherever they are
I always find something to spark a star
I’m the witness to their tales
The curiosities of life make me prevail
That everyone is unique, special in their way
Let’s observe them all, that’s what I say
There’s the one who sings in the shower
Thinking they’re a star, a touch of power
And the one who talks alone in the street
With an invisible handbag, they’re on repeat
I’m the witness to their tales
The curiosities of life make me prevail
That everyone is unique, special in their way
Let’s observe them all, that’s what I say
[ solo ]
So come with me, open your eyes
Let’s observe together, under the skies
In this crazy world, let’s find the reason
To laugh and to sing, observing the season
[outro]
